### LOO Verification (one-off robustness check)

This chunk independently replicates the LOO procedure subject-by-subject
and compares against `fs_loo_result`. It runs only when `run_loo` is
`TRUE` and an `fs_loo_result` is available.  Helper file: `verify_loo.R`.

To spot-check rather than run all `N_loo` subjects, set
`loo_verify_subjects` to a numeric vector (e.g. `1:25`).  Leave it as
`NULL` to verify every subject (~doubles the LOO cost; one-off only).

```{r fs-loo-verify}
#| eval: !expr run_loo
#| cache: false

# Spot-check or full verification?
loo_verify_subjects <- NULL   # NULL = all subjects; e.g. 1:25 for a sample

t0 <- proc.time()

if (!file.exists("verify_loo.R")) {
  warning("verify_loo.R not found in the working directory; ",
          "skipping LOO verification.")
} else {
  source("verify_loo.R")

  loo_check <- verify_loo(
    fs             = fs_result,
    fs_kfold       = fs_loo_result,         # reuse the LOO already computed
    kfold_subjects = loo_verify_subjects,
    seedit         = analysis_seed,
    verbose        = FALSE                  # tables rendered below instead
  )

  timings$loo_verify <- (proc.time() - t0)["elapsed"]

  cat("LOO verification completed in",
      round(timings$loo_verify / 60, 2), "minutes",
      sprintf("(%d subject(s) checked).\n",
              nrow(loo_check$per_subject)))

  knitr::kable(
    loo_check$summary,
    caption = "LOO verification: per-subject agreement between manual replication and forestsearch_Kfold().",
    col.names = c("Metric", "Value")
  )

  if (nrow(loo_check$disagreements) > 0L) {
    cat("\n**Disagreements detected — investigate before reporting LOO results:**\n\n")
    knitr::kable(
      loo_check$disagreements[, c("subject_idx", "subject_id",
                                  "manual_recommend", "kfold_recommend",
                                  "manual_sg")],
      caption = "Subjects where manual LOO and forestsearch_Kfold() disagree.",
      col.names = c("Row", "Subject ID",
                    "Manual: treat.recommend",
                    "K-fold: treat.recommend",
                    "Manual training-fold subgroup")
    )
  } else {
    cat("\nAll subjects agree — `forestsearch_Kfold(Kfolds = N_loo)` ",
        "implements the LOO procedure as expected.\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
